confidence_notes: Six searches were used. Beer (R$15), cappuccino (R$12.56), inexpensive meal (R$45) and mid-range dinner for two (about R$235) come from Numbeo's Florianópolis page as shown in search summaries. CityCost (R$239) and Expatistan (R$237) give similar dinner-for-two figures. I converted these at about R$5.1 per USD, a rate implied by Expatistan and MyLifeElsewhere conversions, not an official rate. Numbeo is crowdsourced and its survey date is unclear. Cocktail is based on a nightlife guide range of R$30-50 and a beach-kiosk caipirinha at about R$40, and I took the lower middle of that range. I found no direct glass-of-wine price. I estimated it from the beer price, a roughly R$43 bottle of decent wine, and typical Brazilian restaurant pours. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge for July, which is winter with school-holiday demand. They are not from live listings and are the least certain anchors. The RBA rate was read from a search summary of the RBA pages.
comparable_city_reasoning: Florianópolis is a tourist-oriented southern Brazilian city with prices above the Brazilian average. I benchmarked it to other mid-priced Brazilian coastal and southern cities and to Numbeo and Expatistan data for Florianópolis itself.
